title: Drum of Reversal

description.main: The zine Artists Space published for Drum of Reversal, its two-day festival on Mike Kelley in November 2026. It gathers archival material and recollections by fourteen of Kelley's friends and peers around the US premiere of footage of three performances he gave at Hallwalls, Buffalo, in 1981.
description.extended:
The zine Artists Space published for Drum of Reversal, its two-day festival on Mike Kelley in November 2026, pairs archival material with recollections of the artist by fourteen friends and peers.

The cover reproduces the flyer for the evening the festival was built around, printed in black on light blue stock. The front carries the hand-lettered "Mike Kelley Performs, Thurs. April 30, 8:30 P.M." The back gives the Hallwalls address and the three titles: The Monitor and the Merrimac, The Big Tent, and My Space. Inside, black-and-white performance photographs run on black pages beside short first-person texts. The writers are Ericka Beckman, Dorit Cypis, Kim Gordon, Claudia Gould, Carole Ann Klonarides, David Kulik, John Miller, Matt Mullican, Tony Oursler, Lee Ranaldo, Valerie Smith, Dan Walworth, Johanna Went, and Christopher Williams.

Kelley (1954–2012) performed the three pieces in succession at Hallwalls in Buffalo on April 30, 1981. They ran forty-five uninterrupted minutes, with Tony Oursler and Tony Conrad beating drums, playing violin, and taking speaking roles. Kelley resisted having his early performances filmed, and the footage was never screened in his lifetime. A restored version had its US premiere at Artists Space on November 15, 2026. The Mike Kelley Foundation for the Arts supported the festival.
description.exhibition_context: Drum of Reversal, Artists Space, New York, November 15 and 16, 2026. Day one: US premiere of the restored Hallwalls documentation with performances, talks, videos, music and zines by Felix Bernstein, Paul Chan, Richard Hawkins, Julia Heyward, Marc Kokopeli, Jennifer Krasinski, Maggie Lee, Danny McDonald, Aki Sasamoto, Nicole-Antonia Spagnola and SoiL Thornton. Day two: a Mike Kelley edition of Abasement headlined by Paul McCarthy, Rick Potts, Alex Stevens and John Wiese.

notes: Zine accompanying Drum of Reversal, a two-day festival celebrating Mike Kelley at Artists Space, New York, November 15 and 16, 2026, organized with the support of the Mike Kelley Foundation for the Arts. Shown in the library's Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/p/Df0Inn_m_W9/. The zine has no title on its cover, which reproduces the 1981 Hallwalls flyer ("Mike Kelley Performs"); catalogued under the festival title. Cover image is the library's own photograph from that post. No ISBN. Page count and dimensions not recorded. Artists Space names no editor or designer.
